publisher: Scottish Government – Council Tax datasets (Council Tax Assumptions)
source_release: CTAS 2026 - Council Tax Assumptions - Band D Council Tax rates by year - 1996-97 to 2026-27.xlsx
source_id: Scotland row, Band D Council Tax by year
methodology: Scotland average Band D (weighted by Band D equivalents), key = year the financial year starts (2025 = 2025-26). Band ratios: England-style 6/9...18/9 until 2016-17; 240/360...882/360 from 2017-18 (higher bands E-H pay more).
limitations: Scotland only. Band D is a reference band, not the typical bill. Water and waste-water charges (billed with Council Tax in Scotland) are not included. Council Tax Reduction not modelled.
label: Average Band D Council Tax, Scotland (£ per year)
